summary: Pre-alpha (Step 91): the headless CLI (file inspection, image assets of Markdown documents) and the editor window (editing, files, Markdown preview, Ctrl+V images)

commands.name: version
commands.summary: Jarak's version and the contract and schema versions it speaks

commands.name: paths
commands.summary: Where Jarak keeps its settings, session and recovery files; reads nothing and creates nothing

commands.name: open
commands.summary: Start the Jarak window (jarak-gui.exe next to jarak.exe) with these files, or hand them to the running window; a missing file opens as a new document and is created only when you save

commands.name: info
commands.summary: A file's encoding, byte-order mark, line endings, size and line count, and whether Jarak can save it unchanged (lossless) or opens it read-only; changes nothing

commands.name: assets.list
commands.summary: The images a Markdown document refers to (found, missing, remote, outside its folder) and the files in its assets folder no Markdown file there refers to; changes and deletes nothing

commands.name: assets.rename
commands.summary: Renames an image asset of a Markdown document and rewrites the document's references to it (encoding and line endings kept); never replaces a file and refuses an asset other documents in the folder use
